recent_posts.title: Apple adds official Vision Pro support to Godot game engine
recent_posts.summary: Apple is contributing official support for its Vision Pro headset to the Godot game engine. The initial contribution lays the groundwork for running Godot applications natively on visionOS, with plans to introduce a new VR plugin for immersive experiences. The development process is structured into three sequential pull requests: platform support, Swift integration, and the Vision Pro VR plugin. The update will not support OpenGL, opting for Metal as the rendering backend. Apple is seeking community feedback and assistance in various testing areas.

recent_posts.title: EU DMA: Apple and Meta hit with first major fines
recent_posts.summary: The EU has imposed significant fines on Apple and Meta under the Digital Markets Act (DMA) for non-compliance. Apple was fined €500 million for restricting app developers from informing users about alternative purchasing options outside the App Store. Meta was fined €200 million for its 'Consent or Pay' model, which did not allow users to opt for a less personalized but equivalent service without paying a fee. These fines underscore the EU's commitment to ensuring fair and competitive digital markets. Both companies have 60 days to comply with the Commission’s decisions or face further penalties.

recent_posts.title: Endor Labs deploys AI agents to counter vibe coding risks
recent_posts.summary: Endor Labs has enhanced its application security platform with AI agents to address risks from AI-assisted development and vibe coding. These agents utilize an extensive security dataset to prioritize threats, suggest solutions, and implement fixes automatically. This development comes in response to increasing AI-generated code, which introduces security challenges that traditional tools struggle to handle. The platform aims to streamline security processes and improve code safety within AI-native coding environments.

recent_posts.title: Skills gaps hinder UK software deployment success
recent_posts.summary: UK teams are experiencing significant delays in software deployment due to skills gaps, costing organizations an average of £107,000 annually. A Gearset study highlighted that UK software deployments are 26% more likely to be delayed. Key metrics from the DORA report place UK performance in the 'low performing' category, with major delays attributed to under-resourced teams and an IT skills shortage affecting 87% of teams. Misalignment between business leaders and IT departments on the causes of delays further complicates efforts to improve deployment success.

recent_posts.title: Mozilla open-source tools help developers build ethical AI datasets
recent_posts.summary: Mozilla has introduced open-source tools to assist developers in creating ethical AI datasets, avoiding the use of copyrighted material. In collaboration with EleutherAI, Mozilla released toolkits like Whisper for self-hosted audio transcription and Docling for converting diverse documents to Markdown. These tools aim to foster the creation of high-quality, ethically sound datasets while promoting open data and transparency in AI development.

recent_posts.title: Google found guilty of ad tech monopoly in antitrust case
recent_posts.summary: A US District Court has found Google liable for monopolizing key segments of the digital advertising technology market. The court concluded that Google unlawfully acquired and maintained monopoly power in the markets for publisher ad servers and ad exchanges and engaged in illegal tying practices. The case was brought by the US federal government and several states, citing violations of the Sherman Antitrust Act. Google plans to appeal parts of the decision.

recent_posts.title: JetBrains debuts free AI tier and Junie coding agent in IDEs
recent_posts.summary: JetBrains has introduced a unified subscription model for its AI tools, including a new coding agent, Junie, and an upgraded AI Assistant. The subscription includes a free tier offering unlimited code completion and access to local and cloud AI models. Paid tiers provide enhanced features for demanding workflows. Junie, designed as a virtual collaborator, integrates leading large language models to assist with various coding tasks. Significant upgrades to the AI Assistant include better cloud model integration, improved code completion, and enhanced privacy protections.

recent_posts.title: Masquerading payment npm package installs backdoor
recent_posts.summary: Cybersecurity researchers at Socket have discovered a malicious npm package, @naderabdi/merchant-advcash, that hijacks server control during payment transactions. The package, designed to look like a legitimate integration for the Advcash payment platform, activates a reverse shell upon successful payment, allowing attackers to remotely control systems. The sophistication of the module, including its delayed activation and minimal footprint, helps it evade static analysis tools. Developers are reminded to be cautious and not blindly trust external packages.

recent_posts.title: Microsoft Research teaches AI tools how to debug code
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft Research has introduced debug-gym, an environment designed to train AI coding tools in debugging code. As AI-generated code increases, the need for efficient debugging grows. Debug-gym aims to equip AI with the ability to use interactive debugging tools, improving performance and productivity in software development. Initial experiments showed significant improvement in success rates when debugging tools were used, highlighting the potential of this research direction. Microsoft plans to fine-tune LLMs for interactive debugging and encourages community contribution through the open-sourcing of debug-gym.

recent_posts.title: Letting AI agents navigate and interact with the web
recent_posts.summary: AI development is advancing with AI agents that can autonomously navigate and interact with the web, pulling fresh information in real-time to execute tasks such as booking tickets, monitoring updates, or trading stocks. These agents utilize dynamic exploration and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enhance their accuracy and functionality. They employ planning and execution strategies, leveraging tools like Playwright and Selenium for web interaction, and require specialized browsers like Bright Data's Scraping Browser for scalable access to information.
